usdRate.note: Secondary source because the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page; the World Bank official rate PA.NUS.FCRF averaged 37.26 in 2025. The Suriname dollar floats.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Algemeen Bureau voor de Statistiek (ABS), CPI Suriname September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Prices in September 2026 were 7.3% higher than in September 2025 (index 979.7, April-June 2016 = 100; monthly change 0.1%); provisional figure.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF 2025 Article IV (February 2026): CPI end-2026 9.7%, 2027 6.1%, 5.0% from 2028; ABS CPI 7.3% (September 2026)
inflation_projection.note: Suriname has no inflation target and a history of very high inflation (over 50% in 2023), so we plan with 7%, above the IMF's 5% medium-term projection.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Suriname interest rate (Central Bank of Suriname discount rate)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source because the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page: the discount rate at which the central bank lends to banks is 10% (October 2026). The central bank steers reserve money through open market operations rather than a point policy rate (IMF 2025 Article IV).

savings_account_rate.note: Searched for bank savings rates: the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page, and no other public source of savings account rates was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Searched for 3-month term deposit rates: the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page, and no other public source was found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Searched for 1-year term deposit rates: the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page, and no other public source was found.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Suriname deposit interest rate (Central Bank of Suriname data)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Secondary source because the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page: average deposit rate 7% in August 2026, unchanged from July; World Bank FR.INR.DPST gives 6.69% for 2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond was found. The central bank has sold its own certificates to retail investors at times in 2023-2025, which the IMF (2025 Article IV) recommends stopping; their rates could not be read.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current Treasury bill yield is published: the IMF 2025 Article IV (February 2026) reports that the operationalisation of Treasury bill auctions is still pending.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year domestic government bond yield was found; domestic debt markets are undeveloped (IMF 2025 Article IV).

tbond_10y_rate.note: No published 10-year domestic government bond yield was found; domestic debt markets are undeveloped (IMF 2025 Article IV).

tax_bank_interest.note: Searched the Belastingdienst Suriname site (income tax pages and laws list) and PwC Tax Summaries (no Suriname page): no readable statement of how interest on bank deposits is taxed for residents was found.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals in Suriname (see sanchayapatra_5y_rate), so no tax rate applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Searched Government of Suriname and IMF sources: no operating deposit insurance scheme or cover limit was found (the Central Bank of Suriname website blocks automated reading behind a verification page).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap on credit card interest and no official typical rate were found; the average bank lending rate was 13.7% in August 2026 (Trading Economics, central bank data).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the local stock market is tiny and illiquid, so we use a global equity index in Suriname-dollar terms, with a weak global decade and a stable currency.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: global equities (about 6.5% in US dollars) plus some expected depreciation of the Suriname dollar, capped at the 7% deposit rate plus 3 points because there is no usable local index record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities and faster depreciation of the Suriname dollar, which has lost most of its value since 2020.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF: SRD 37.26 per US dollar (2025 average); SRD 37.44 (October 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stable Suriname dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF: SRD 37.26 per US dollar (2025 average); IMF medium-term inflation 5%
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4.5% a year plus about 4.5% a year of expected Suriname-dollar depreciation (inflation gap with the US).

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF: SRD 37.26 per US dollar (2025 average)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold prices and renewed currency depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts and short deposits pay well below the 7% average deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits around the 7% average deposit rate, less possible tax on interest (not confirmed).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits slightly above the average deposit rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio is published; insurance supervision rules are still being developed (the Insurance Act was submitted to Parliament in June 2024, IMF 2025 Article IV).

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Suriname, but no regulator or other non-company source publishes premium rates by age.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found for Suriname.

health_premium_table.note: Health cover is mainly the compulsory national basic health insurance, priced as a flat monthly premium by age (SRD 55-240 a month on the government page https://gov.sr/thema/basiszorgverzekering/, older than 2025), not per 100,000 of cover; no source of private top-up premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 19.7% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.note: No long-run medical CPI series was found; we plan with headline planning inflation plus 2 points for private and imported medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: No long-run education CPI series was found; we plan with headline planning inflation plus 1 point.

life_expectancy.note: Men 70.6, women 77.0 (2024). UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 74.0 for 2026 (men 70.9, women 77.3). The World Bank figure is for 2024, older than 2025 (latest published).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for the year 2026 (asOf set to mid-year); sex-specific values are for the 5-year age groups starting at each age; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 12.3 (2025, World Bank), 19.7 (2040) and 29.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/suriname/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age in Suriname is 60 under the Wet Algemeen Pensioen 2014, the same for men and women; the AOV also starts at 60. Page dated April 2022 (older than 2025); no change found since.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Ministry of Home Affairs (Binnenlandse Zaken), Government of Suriname
retirement_age_government.note: The statutory pension age for civil servants is 60, with extension by employment contract for up to five years.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings and short deposits paying well below the average deposit rate.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the 7% average deposit rate, allowing for lower rates on liquid deposits and possible tax on interest.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: term deposits at about the average deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026); global equity assumptions in SRD
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits and global equities.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026); global equity assumptions in SRD
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half global equities at 10% and half deposits around 6% in Suriname-dollar terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Average bank deposit rate 7.0% (August 2026, Central Bank of Suriname via Trading Economics); inflation 7.3% (September 2026); global equity assumptions in SRD
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with stronger equity returns and currency depreciation.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: UN ECLAC non-contributory pensions database: Universal Old Age Pension (AOV), Suriname; Ministry of Finance and Planning (31 May 2026)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The universal AOV (Algemene Oudedagsvoorziening) is SRD 2,250 a month since March 2025 (ECLAC). The Ministry of Finance and Planning confirmed on 31 May 2026 that AOV was not increased in 2026 (https://gov.sr/ministerie-verduidelijkt-uitbetaling-sociale-uitkeringen/); a separate temporary supplement of SRD 1,000 was paid in some months of 2026.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: UN ECLAC non-contributory pensions database: Universal Old Age Pension (AOV), Suriname
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: AOV from age 60 for Surinamese citizens and for foreign nationals resident in Suriname for at least 10 years; universal, not means-tested; financed from general revenue and a 4% levy on the taxable income of residents under 60.

gratuity_rule.note: Searched Government of Suriname sources: whether labour law provides any statutory payment on retirement could not be confirmed (no readable text of the labour laws was found).

public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory general pension for all working residents (in force 8 December 2014), run by the Algemeen Pensioenfonds: premium example 3% of wages, at least half paid by the employer; pension from 60 after at least 5 years of premiums, separate from the AOV (the page also cites a minimum of SRD 825 a month including an AOV of SRD 525, an outdated AOV level). No indexation is stated; tax treatment not confirmed. Page dated April 2022 (older than 2025).

savings_account.note: Offered by commercial banks; rates could not be read from central bank statistics.

fdr_3m.note: Offered by commercial banks; no public rate table was readable.

fdr_1y.note: Offered by commercial banks; no public rate table was readable.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond; central bank certificates have occasionally been sold to retail investors, which the IMF recommends stopping.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bill auctions are not yet operational (IMF 2025 Article IV, February 2026).

tbond_5y.note: No domestic government bond market open to individuals was found.

tbond_10y.note: No domestic government bond market open to individuals was found.

equity_fund.note: No locally registered retail equity or index fund was identified; the local stock market is very small.

gold.note: Suriname is a gold producer and buying gold is legal; mostly sold as jewellery and small bars.

insuranceRegulator.name: Centrale Bank van Suriname (CBvS), supervision of insurers and pension funds
insuranceRegulator.note: A new Insurance Act was submitted to Parliament in June 2024 (IMF 2025 Article IV).

oldAgeAllowance.name: Algemene Oudedagsvoorziening (AOV), Ministry of Social Affairs and Housing
oldAgeAllowance.note: Universal pension from age 60, paid by the AOV Fund.

publicHealthCover.name: Staatsziekenfonds (SZF) and the national basic health insurance (Basiszorgverzekering)
publicHealthCover.note: Basic health insurance is compulsory; the government pays the premium for Surinamese children up to 16 and people 60 and older (https://gov.sr/thema/basiszorgverzekering/).
